acceptanceCriteria: Prove the whole callback argument is a bounded inline function, or abstain with unknown/callback.
Add regression cases for function() {} && namedCallback with test.step, expect.poll, toPass, toThrow and toThrowError; none may produce navigation-only.
Preserve passing direct-name rejection, inline read-only navigation, and inline mutating callback classification; retain focused ANL-V0-035 evidence.
body: Confirmed in review of 469344d29396d7003f10bd7796c950feeca8304c (V1-1164), source unchanged at d6cab15d78a1f7359fa90307954746e86fda168d. internal/appmap/effects.go:576-577 accepts a function keyword without proving the complete argument is a function. Reproduction: define reset = () => localStorage.setItem('x','1') and check = reset before the test; between page-object constructions use test.step('reset', function() {} && reset), expect.poll(function() {} && check).toBe(1), expect(function() {} && check).toPass(), or expect(function() {} && reset).toThrow(). Temporary Go-overlay fixture probes using fixtureRepo/effectSpec/build verified two sequence edges, then observed navigation-only for all four despite the argument evaluating to reset/check. Expected unknown with effect_call callback. Existing TestANLV0035StepEffects passes and covers only direct names and pure inline callbacks, not these compound arguments. Direct expect(reset).toThrow()/toThrowError() probes yield unknown callback. Tested with go1.27.2 (repository pinned go1.27.1 not present); Core 1.0.0-rc.3 build 407 / Tasks 0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.407. Review probes used scratch overlays, no source edits.

completion.reason: Delivered in beamfall/corvint#801 (https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/801; landed by batch PR #801); on main at 8f032d969f26dc0d3bd10ec0248566070161272d (https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/801). Tests named in the PR: appmap effects_test funcexpr/stepfunc/throwfunc cases (fixed in 847faf35b). Doc gates, repin check, independent review and dogfood bind/check/seal reported PASS in the PR. make gate NOT_RUN (owner scoped-work preference). Evidence: sha256 of the build-log/decision record(s) at the merge commit.
